connector.name: RetentionCheck
connector.registryDescription: Pull churn from Stripe, Postgres, MySQL, or pasted feedback. AI-ranked drivers + fixes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the brianfofficial account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key for running churn analysis (required for analyze_churn, analyze_stripe_churn, and analyze_sql_churn; get_example_analysis works without it).

env.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Stripe API key for analyze_stripe_churn. Use a RESTRICTED (read-only) key with these permissions: Subscriptions Read, Customers Read, Prices Read. Create one at https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys/create. Optional — only required for the analyze_stripe_churn tool.

env.name: POSTGRES_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string for analyze_sql_churn when dialect='postgres'. Format: postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db?sslmode=require. Use a READ-ONLY user — see retentioncheck.com/integrations for the exact GRANT SQL. Optional — only required for the analyze_sql_churn tool with postgres dialect.

env.name: MYSQL_URL
env.description: MySQL connection string for analyze_sql_churn when dialect='mysql'. Format: mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db?ssl=true. Use a READ-ONLY user — see retentioncheck.com/integrations for the exact GRANT SQL. Optional — only required for the analyze_sql_churn tool with mysql dialect.

env.name: RETENTIONCHECK_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to 0 to opt out of anonymous usage telemetry. Telemetry tracks tool invocations and aggregate counts — never the feedback text, financial values, or any PII.
